sections.title: Beyond parents and siblings
sections.content: You already know the immediate family from A1. Here's the rest of the family tree: nagybácsi (uncle), nagynéni (aunt), unokatestvér (cousin), unoka (grandchild), and the general word nagyszülő (grandparent) for nagymama/nagypapa together.

items.english: Anna and András are my cousins.
I have a cousin in South Africa.

sections.content: nagyszülő covers both grandparents together the way szülő covers both parents — you already know exactly how that pattern works from A1.
